brief: One-and-a-half-storey 1930 Art Deco newspaper building: dark red brick wings with cast-stone rosettes and a zigzag frieze flank a tall white limestone entrance frontispiece that steps up to a ball finial. The paper's name is carved across the stepped parapet; below, fluted pilasters frame a deep round arch with chevron-carved voussoirs over a big multi-pane lunette window with an iron balconet. Red-painted panels fill the old side window openings (press room behind).
